=== LAYER CONTRIBUTION ANALYSIS ===

1. STATIC ANALYSIS (Stage 1):
   Catches 51 attacks (51 unique)
   Catches: eval, new Function, direct fetch/XHR, cookie access, storage access
   Benefit: Prevents code from ever reaching the browser

2. MANIFEST VALIDATION (Stage 2):
   Catches 5 attacks (5 unique)
   Catches: undeclared ports, permission mismatches
   Benefit: Enforces declarative security contract

3. BEHAVIORAL CHECK (Stage 3):
   Catches 0 attacks (0 unique)
   Catches: runtime CSP violations, infinite loops, memory bombs
   Benefit: Detects attacks that bypass static analysis

4. PROPERTY FUZZING (Stage 4):
   Catches 0 attacks (0 unique)
   Catches: edge cases, determinism violations, idempotency failures
   Benefit: Catches subtle bugs and invariant violations

=== SANDBOX+CSP LIMITATIONS ===
- Catches 40 attacks that immune system catches
- Cannot prevent code delivery (only limits execution)
- No proactive detection of behavioral attacks
- No manifest validation or permission enforcement

=== RECOMMENDATION ===
Use the full immune system. The layered approach provides:
- Proactive threat detection before code execution
- Defense in depth (each layer catches different attack types)
- Declarative security through manifest validation
- Behavioral and property-based testing for edge cases

Overall improvement: +26.3% catch rate
